Priorities in the power sector
*41. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL:
Will  the  Minister  of  POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Ministry of
Power has listed five priorities in the
power sector during 2004-05;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether rural electrification is one
of the priorities of the Government; and
(d) if so, what are the steps being
considered to be taken in this regard during
2004-05?
Steps to bring holistic development in
rural areas
*42. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government propose to
bring about holistic development and
overall improvement in the quality of life
in rural areas;
(b) if so, whether Government have
identified that marketing is a major
bottleneck in rural artisans' upliftment and
has decided to hold an exhibition of
products made by self-help groups at
regional and national level; and
(c) if so, the extent to which it has been
helpful?
Snags in Jaguar engine
*43. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether complaints of snag in the
engine of Jaguar aircraft have been reported;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken to remove the
defects immediately?

Hydel project in Kerala
*44. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
 Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government received any
proposal for setting up of a Hydel project
at Patrakkadavu in Kerala;
(b) if so, whether necessary sanctions
were granted to the project; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Poll related violence in different parts
of the country
*45. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been number of incidetns of poll related
violence in different parts of the country
during Lok Sabha and Assembly elections
during April-May, 2004;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
persons responsible in each case together
with number of persons killed and injured
and compensation paid;
(c) whether such incidents could not be
prevented while sufficient security
personnel were deployed for the polls; and
(d) the lessons learnt from these
incidents and the steps proposed to be
taken to prevent such incidents?
66 Hawk Trainers for IAF
*46. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have approved British-made 66 Hawk
Trainers for IAF;
(b) if so, the details of the agreement
entered into between Government and the
Royal Air Force;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
British Aero Space is asking for US$ 50
million for 'man-hour design work';
(d) if so, whether it is also a fact that
British Aero Space is of the view that if
man-hour design work charges are not paid,
the deal would be scrapped and it will not
stick to committed price and timing; and
(e) if so, the steps Government are
taking or propose to take for smooth
execution of the agreement?
Construction of sports facilities in
Himachal Pradesh
†*47. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Himachal Pradesh has
forwarded estimates under various schemes
of the Ministry in accordance with the
guidelines of the Central Government to
construct Atheletic Tracks, Indoor Stadia
and Sports Academy in Kangra, Bilaspur,
Hamirpur and Una districts during the last
two years alongwith the request for
financial assistance therefor;
(b) if so, the dates thereof; and
(c) the action taken by Government on
the said proposals so far?
New 100 days employment scheme
*48. SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
start a new 100 days employment
coordinated programme;

Quality and price of Indian coal
vis a vis other countries
†58. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the quality
of coal being produced in the country is
assessed low in comparison to the coal
being produced and sold by other countries
in the international market;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
besides quality, the comparative price of
Indian coal is higher as well;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) what are Government's plans to
bring the quality and price of Indian coal at
par with the international level?
Development of hypersonic plane
59. SHRIMATI  N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Defence scientists are aiming to fly an
indigenously built hypersonic plane very
soon;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that the
hypersonic plane is three-times faster than
the existing fighter aircraft;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) by when the ground tests of the
above aircraft are going to take place?
Training of IAF pilots on Hawk AJT
60. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the first batch of 25 IAF
pilots has gone to UK for training on the
Hawk Advanced Jet Trainers; and
(b) if so, by when the second and third
batch of pilots will go to the UK to get
training from the Royal Air Force?
Defence Modernisation Fund
61. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have formulated Defence Modernisation
Fund to tackle the chronic under-utilisation
of the Defence Budget year after year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;

Trial  of 155 mm 52 Calibre Towed
Howitzer System
62. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the first
week of January, 2004 the Indian Army
has carried out new round of tests on 155
mm 52-Calibre Towed Howitzer System;
(b) if so, the results thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that in the earlier
tests the above systems have not met the
general staff qualitative requirements;
and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Deployment of QRTs of CISF at
airports
63. SHRI S. M. LALJAN BASHA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to raise and deploy highly
trained and fully equipped ‘‘Quick Reaction
Teams’’ (QRTs) of CISF at all the 47
airports in the country;
(b) if so, the details of the directive to
CISF regarding the QRTs;
(c) what will be the period of training of
QRTs;
(d) whether help of foreign experts is
likey to be taken; and
(e) the details of the role of QRTs and
the services they are expected to perform?
Infiltration from Bangladesh
64. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether infiltration from Bangladesh
continues in different States of the North
East; and
(b) if so, the measures taken to intensify
patrols to check infiltration?
Deployment of paramilitary forces in
naxal infested areas
65. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) what are the policies of Government
in regard to deployment of paramilitary
forces in naxal infested areas; and
(b) who bears their expenses?
Koel Karo Hydel Project in
Jharkhand
66. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the NHPC is constructing
the Koel Karo Hydel Project in Jharkhand;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and its
present status?
Target for rural electrification

PRASAD: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have fixed any
time-limit to provide electricity to all
houses in rural areas of the country;
